name: Tyran.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Tyran.io is a free iogame.

Welcome to the terrifying world of Tyran.io. A world where humans compete for weapons, items, and upgrades so they can unlock dinosaur eggs to grow themselves a dino-partner they can use to take on other opponents. That's right, in this arena free for all, not only will you be going toe to toe with other human competitors from around the world, but you'll be fighting ace to face with a collection of Scary dinosaurs that you can ride. Strategize which weapons and upgrades you think might work best with your dino of choice and then hop on and gallop around taking enemies. It is an extreme game of extreme face to face battles that go from awesome to epic when you introduce dino riding to the equation. Do not let the cute animations fool you, this game might look adorable but when you get right down to the nuts and bolts it is absolutely terrifying. Mount the dino of your choice and stomp your way to victory in this fully engaging game of combat and conquest.
